title: Sync with Nightscout - duplicate entries
body:
When entering treatments via nightscout, it appears Xdrip downloads and then re-uploads the treatment data.  For example, the following two duplicate entries occur in the MongoDB.  Is there a setting or way to fix this so only the nightscout entry is created and used?  Also note that Xdrip only shows the one entry whereas nightscout shows both.

Thanks!

Xdrip version: 05bd730-2019.04.13
Nightscout: 0.11.1 head

`{
    "_id": {
        "$oid": "b4696d08d1d74ba9a20615d4"
    },
    "timestamp": 1555344333435,
    "eventType": "Correction Bolus",
    "enteredBy": "sync",
    "notes": "ra",
    "uuid": "b4696d08-d1d7-4ba9-a206-15d461c79237",
    "insulin": 5,
    "created_at": "2019-04-15T16:05:33.435Z",
    "sysTime": "2019-04-15T11:05:33.435-0500"
}`

`{
    "_id": {
        "$oid": "5cb4abcd64c3784ebe4b3ad2"
    },
    "enteredBy": "",
    "eventType": "Correction Bolus",
    "reason": "",
    "insulin": 5,
    "duration": 0,
    "notes": "ra",
    "created_at": "2019-04-15T16:05:33.435Z"
}`

comments.body:
I noticed that if I turn my Xdrip+ collector phone off when doing a carb entry in Nightscout, there are no duplicate entries.  So this appears to be a synchronization problem.  

For example, with the phone off, only the following entry is in MongoDB:
`{
    "_id": {
        "$oid": "5cbdf47964c3784ebe616f48"
    },
    "enteredBy": "bob",
    "eventType": "Carb Correction",
    "reason": "",
    "carbs": 111,
    "duration": 0,
    "notes": "test entry from nightscout",
    "created_at": "2019-04-22T17:06:01.332Z"
}`
Figured out that xdrip settings->inter-app->accept_treatments ON was the culprit.  Solved by switching to OFF
